reason: The plugin is primarily a local desktop launcher shell for DeepSeek Harness. Evidence shows it wraps an existing web profile into an Electron app with tray residency, single-instance window handling, and local server lifecycle checks, making its core purpose a desktop convenience interface and process manager rather than content generation, networking service, or code tooling.

summaries.zh: 本插件为 DeepSeek Harness 提供桌面启动器外壳，可检查并启动/复用本地 web 服务，并在 Electron 原生窗口中打开界面，支持托盘常驻与后台驻留交互。
summaries.en: This plugin is a desktop launcher shell for DeepSeek Harness that checks for or starts a local server and opens the web UI in an Electron window, with tray-based resident behavior for quick access.

capabilities: starts or reuses a local process-defined server via configurable command
opens a native Electron window for a local web UI
manages system tray behavior and single-instance window focus
performs local port/endpoint checks to coordinate app lifecycle
reads local config and writes local log files

reasons.code: Repository README describes a tray-resident Electron wrapper that checks 127.0.0.1:3080, starts dsh when needed, and opens the web UI in a native window.
README documents configurable shell settings including dshCommand, cwd, env, and port in config.json, indicating user-defined local process execution behavior.
package.json exposes an Electron main entry (main.js) and a bundle patch, with package purpose aligned to desktop launcher and launch-time behavior.
